decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed extensions by reason of their size, appearance and proximity to the adjoining properties, would represent an obtrusive and unneighbourly development, which would harm the living conditions of the adjoining neighbours, by reason of enclosure, shading, and loss of outlook, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - The proposed extensions by reason of their size, position and unsympathetic appearance, would represent an obtrusive overdevelopment of the site which would be at odds with the architectural character of the existing house, would destroy the spacing and pattern of existing development within the street scene and would result in unacceptable harm to the character and appearance of the Cranford Village Conservation Area, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Demolition of existing garage and erection of a two-storey front and side extension and a single-storey rear extension to existing house within Cranford Village Conservation Area.
